annotations.title: Name the contact of a ledger line

description: Names the contact of an open line on a receivable or payable account that names nobody — the open items of books imported line by line — once, from nothing to a contact of the same company, and learns the label as a motif of that contact for the next suggestion. Refused by name: unknown_line, line_not_posted, line_has_contact (a posted counterparty is corrected by reversing the entry), line_matched (unmatch it first, and only when the user says so), line_not_third_party, unknown_contact. Changes no amount, account or tax box. Show the user the candidates of suggest_line_contacts and ask which one before calling it; never pick one yourself.

contact_id.description: The contact the user chose for it — one of the candidates, or one they created with create_contact. A contact of the same company.

line_id.description: The open ledger line on a receivable or payable account that names nobody, as suggest_line_contacts returns it.

name: set_line_contact
